With the official Montreal Canadiens mobile application, Habs fans won’t miss any of the action.
With its fresh look and ergonomics, the application will allow you to be even closer to your favorite team with daily news coverage from canadiens.com, exclusive HabsTV videos, along with access to contests and promotions from the unified news feed featured on the home screen.
With your Club 1909 account, you can collect points by participating in challenges, including the question of the day, and eventually claim the prize of your dreams.
You can also manage your tickets for Canadiens games at the Bell Centre from the application: buy and transfer tickets and access your mobile tickets.

Download the application for access to:
- A unified news feed containing news from canadiens.com, HabsTV videos, exclusive promotions and contests
- A mobile ticketing system allowing to buy and manage your tickets for games at the Bell Centre
- Your Club 1909 account and Ticketmaster
- The latest news, reports and more
- A “Games” section to collect Club 1909 points
- “Game Day” content – articles and pre-game videos, game recaps, statistics and real-time information before, during and after the game
- The real-time score and a game summary, along with the standings and player statistics
- Enhanced alerts
- Direct access to exclusive HabsTV videos and articles on canadiens.com
- Information on your tickets and special events
